tasks.analysis: Fossils provide invaluable evidence of evolutionary history, documenting species that lived millions of years ago. Paleontologists examine these remains to understand how organisms have changed over time. Natural selection explains how advantageous traits increase in frequency in a population. Species adapt to their environments, which leads to incredible diversity observed in the biological world today through the mechanism of natural selection. The ongoing study of evolution continues to reveal how life on Earth has developed and diversified. 化石为进化史提供了宝贵证据，记录了数百万年前生存的物种。古生物学家通过研究这些遗骸，了解生物如何随时间演变。自然选择解释了有利性状如何在种群中变得更加普遍。物种适应其生存环境，这一过程造就了当今生物界中可见的极高多样性。对进化的持续研究不断揭示地球生命如何形成与多样化。
